department: Department of Biology, Chemistry and Pharmacy (BCP)

deadline.value: Doctoral applications can be made at any time, though committees do not meet during lecture-free periods, so delays may occur.
deadline.quote: You may apply and be admitted at any time.

gre_subject.value: The regulations mention no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The applicant must submit a suggested supervisor, and that supervisor must confirm the role as part of the application.
supervisor.quote: The supervisor according to Section 6 must represent the subject of the dissertation in research and confirm his or her

funding.value: The regulations do not say whether doctoral students are funded.

entry_route.value: Admission normally needs a master's course of 300 credit points, with a bachelor's admission possible only in specific cases.
entry_route.quote: completion of a master’s course equating to 300 credit points

english_waiver.value: B2 English proof is needed only if the doctoral work is written in English. No test score or India rule is stated.
english_waiver.quote: evidence of English language skills at level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR)

notes: The 2018 BCP regulations cover chemistry and biology. The Natural Sciences programme (https://www.fu-berlin.de/sites/naturalsciences/application/index.html) is an add-on with no funding; it needs B2 English.
